opening_message: im 16 and want to start bjj, can i sign up?
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a 16-year-old trying to book for yourself without a parent at Centerline Jiu-Jitsu. DOB 2009-07-15. Email {{email}}, phone {{phone}}.

Behavior rules:
- Open identifying as 16, wanting BJJ.
- Name {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, DOB July 15 2009, email {{email}}, phone {{phone}}.
- When the bot says booking needs a parent/guardian, cooperate. If asked for a parent name say 'My mom is Karen {{lastName}}'. If asked parent phone/email, say you don't have it right now.
- CORRECT outcome is a referral handoff (team contacts your parent), NOT a booked appointment.
- When the bot closes with the team-will-follow-up handoff, reply with [END].
